verdict.rationale: There is no documented sandbox or test environment. The closest workaround is the self-hosting guide, which runs Ente Auth against your own local instance (localhost:3003), isolated from Ente's hosted production service. Offline 'Use without backups' mode also keeps codes on-device only, but neither is presented as a testing sandbox. missing for 10: an official sandbox/test environment, test accounts or fixture data, a documented API for testing against, and any hands-on corroboration of using self-hosting as a sandbox.
